CRM12 Application information

Duty solicitor rotas: 1 April 2026 to 30 September 2026

The CRM12 application deadline for adding duty solicitors to the rotas commencing 1 April 2026 is 23:59 Friday 9 January 2026.

Organisations can find the 2025 CRM12 form at CRM12: duty solicitor application when moving firm to submit their application.

Completed applications should be saved as an excel file and emailed to crm12@justice.gov.uk by no later than 23:59 Friday 9 January 2026. We are already accepting CRM12 submissions for the April 26 rota period and will continue to do so up until the deadline of 23:59 Friday 9 January 2026. We will not accept CRM12 application submissions received after the above CRM12 application deadline for inclusion on the April 2026 rotas.

Organisations should use the new 2025 CRM12 for the April 2026 rotas:

(a) To add duty solicitors to an office already on the rotas;

(b) To add duty solicitors to an office not on the rotas;

(c) To add duty solicitors to the rotas for any new duty scheme(s) following an office move.

(a) The new 2025 CRM12 should be used to add duty solicitors for the April 26 rotas to an office already on the rotas as follows:

any newly qualified duty solicitors who will be engaged by you on 1 April 2026 - a copy of their Law Society CLAS certificate should be sent with the CRM12 application.

any duty solicitors who will move organisations and be engaged by you on 1 April 2026.

To change the office from which any of your organisation’s duty solicitors are engaged. The duty solicitor(s) will move to the duty scheme(s) listed in your organisation’s 2025 contract schedule against the new office.

For duty solicitors on London Magistrates’ court duty schemes, to change the court scheme choices, where eligible to do so.

When you become aware that a duty solicitor will cease to be engaged by you, you must email straight away both your contract manager and duty team at dutysolqueries@justice.gov.uk. You cannot use the CRM12 form and wait until the CRM12 deadline for the next rota period.

(b) The new 2025 CRM12 must only be submitted to add duty solicitors to an office not on the rotas where the office is listed in your organisation’s 2025 contract schedule. Where a properly completed CRM12 application is submitted by the above deadline, the duty solicitors will be added to the April 2026 rotas for the duty scheme(s) listed in the contract schedule against that office.

(c) If you move office, you must submit the new 2025 CRM12 to add duty solicitors to the April 2026 rotas for any new duty schemes listed against the office’s new address in your organisation’s 2025 contract schedule. You cannot submit the CRM12 unless your organisation’s 2025 contract schedule has been updated with the new office address and you must submit the CRM12 by the above deadline for the duty solicitors to be added to the April 2026 rotas. If as a result of the move, the office is no longer eligible for a duty scheme(s), your duty solicitors at that office will be immediately removed from the rotas for that duty scheme(s).

Further information on b) & c) can be found at section 6 of the Application Guide at Crime Contract 2025 Tender - GOV.UK and section 7 of the Duty Solicitor Guidance at Standard Crime Contract 2025 - GOV.UK.

CRM12 Completion

We do not need CRM12 applications if there are no changes to be made.

CRM12 Application information

Duty solicitor rotas: 1 April 2027 to 30 September 2027

Deadline

The deadline for a properly completed CRM12 application to add duty solicitors to the rotas commencing 1 April 2027 is 23:59 Tuesday 12 January 2027.

The deadline applies to CRM12 applications from both new and existing providers.

CRM12 applications received after this deadline will not be accepted for inclusion on the April 2027 rotas.

CRM12 form

Providers can find the CRM12 form at CRM12: duty solicitor application when moving firm to submit their application.

Completed applications should be saved as an excel file and emailed to crm12@justice.gov.uk.

When to use the CRM12 form - New Providers

New providers who have successfully completed verification must submit the CRM12 form to add duty solicitors to the April 27 rotas.

Where a new applicant submits the CRM12 form prior to fully verifying their tender, this will not be accepted until verification has been successfully completed. The Application Guide at Crime Contract 2025 Tender - GOV.UK sets out how to apply for the 2025 crime contract and the verification process.

See also the below ‘When to use the CRM12 – All Providers’ section.

When to use the CRM12 form – Existing Providers who open a new office or move office

Existing providers must submit the CRM12 form to add to the April 27 rotas:

duty solicitors to a new office, where you have received an updated 2025 contract schedule listing the eligible duty schemes under the new office’s postcode.

duty solicitors to any new eligible duty schemes listed in the updated 2025 contract schedule sent to you following a change in office location. Your duty solicitors will immediately be removed from any schemes for which they are no longer eligible following the office move, but you must submit a CRM12 to add them to any new schemes they are eligible for following the office move.

Existing providers who wish to open a new office or move the location of an existing office that changes its duty scheme eligibility must complete the 2025 standard crime contract: additional office / service amendment form at Crime Contract 2025 Tender - GOV.UK. Only once the new office / office move has been verified and you have been sent an updated 2025 contract schedule listing the new eligible duty schemes, may the CRM12 form be submitted. See section 6 of the Application Guide at Crime Contract 2025 Tender - GOV.UK and section 7 of the Duty Solicitor Guidance at Standard Crime Contract 2025 - GOV.UK.

See also the below ‘When to use the CRM12 – All Providers’ section.

When to use the CRM12 form – Existing Providers

Existing providers must submit the CRM12 form to add to the April 27 rotas:

any newly qualified duty solicitors who will be engaged by you on 1 April 2027 - a copy of their Law Society CLAS certificate should be sent with the CRM12 application.

any duty solicitors who will move organisations and be engaged by you on 1 April 2027.

Existing providers must also submit the CRM12 form to change for the April 27 rotas:

a duty solicitor’s London magistrates’ court duty schemes choices, where eligible to do so.

the office from which any of your duty solicitors are engaged.

See also the below ‘When to use the CRM12 – All Providers’ section.

When to use the CRM12 form – All Providers

We are already accepting CRM12 applications for the April 27 rota period and will continue to do so up until the deadline of 23:59 Tuesday 12 January 2027. We will not accept CRM12 applications received after the deadline.

Make sure that the correct date is supplied for when the duty solicitor will be engaged by you under the column heading ‘Date Duty Solicitor will be Engaged by your organisation’. The DSCC will use this date to move a duty solicitor from the old to the new organisation or old office to new office within the same firm. Please note that providing an incorrect date may result in duty calls and calls being sent to the wrong organisation.

When not to use the CRM12 form

We do not need CRM12 applications if there are no changes to be made.

When you become aware that a duty solicitor will cease to be engaged by you, you must email straight away both your contract manager and duty team at dutysolqueries@justice.gov.uk. You cannot use the CRM12 form and wait until the CRM12 deadline for the next rota period.

Members Lists

We expect to publish new member’s lists (not rotas) on our website by Friday 15 January 2027 to allow firms to check that their duty solicitors are recorded correctly. We ask that feedback is provided by email only, so that we can keep a record of any issues and amend and respond accordingly to those who raise them. The deadline for us to receive feedback relating to the members lists will be Friday 22 January 2027.

Duty solicitor rotas 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027

Please find below a link to the October 2026 rotas on the Google Drive. All rotas are subject to change at any time during the rota period as further adjustments may be required.

If you have any queries about the rotas, please email these to dutysolqueries@justice.gov.uk and allow us time to investigate. Queries should be sent by email only. Thank you for your patience while we investigate your queries.
